lyrics:
[Intro: muted guitar groove, finger snaps, organ]

[Verse 1: smoky female alto, relaxed]
There's a dent from the year that the money ran dry
There's rust where we stopped saying good night
The radio only gets one station now
And honey, we're still getting around somehow

[Chorus: soulful, full band, stacked harmonies]
We got a good engine and bad paint
We're a little bit of is and a lot of ain't
Don't have to shine to make it up the hill
She turned over this morning and she always will
Call us what you want, baby, call us late
Good engine, bad paint

[Verse 2: alto, bass walking]
Them shiny ones are stranded on the shoulder half the time
All chrome and payments, nothing underneath the shine
We got two hundred thousand, got duct tape on the seat
And I'd still pick you to carry me

[Chorus: soulful, full band, stacked harmonies]
We got a good engine and bad paint
We're a little bit of is and a lot of ain't
Don't have to shine to make it up the hill
She turned over this morning and she always will
Call us what you want, baby, call us late
Good engine, bad paint

[Bridge: half-time, organ swell]
Anybody can love a thing that's new
Takes a long time to love a thing
Like I love you

[Final Chorus: biggest, ad-libs over the top]
We got a good engine and bad paint
We're a little bit of is and a lot of ain't
Don't have to shine to make it up the hill
She turned over this morning and she always will
Call us what you want, baby, call us late
Good engine, bad paint

[Outro: groove, an old engine turning over and catching]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 77 BPM, 4/4, G major. A slow, confident sway with a soul backbeat.

VOICE: Female alto, smoky and unhurried, with a Texas edge and soul phrasing. She leans back on the beat and opens up in the choruses. Her own harmonies stack behind her; she ad-libs over the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A muted, rhythmic electric guitar figure, finger snaps and a deep kick, round bass, Hammond organ, acoustic guitar, a restrained slide guitar, handclaps in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro groove. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:08 Verse 2. 1:36 Chorus 2. 2:04 Bridge, half-time. 2:22 Final chorus with ad-libs. 2:52 Outro, an engine catching at 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2019 pop-soul country: tight, warm and bass-heavy, vocals dry and forward.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The engine turning over and catching at 3:08.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young marriage sure it will last. This one has the mileage to prove it, and is funnier and less tidy about the damage.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Wry, proud, grateful, running.
